messages.subject: WC-00115 - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Vantage's Defence has just come in - attached. As expected they admit the invoices were issued and unpaid but plead an unparticularised set-off, and they now allege service failures from October 2024 to justify termination (plus a variation-by-conduct argument). No particulars of the service failures at all.

I think we press for further information and consider summary judgment on the debt. Will get counsel's view.

Tom

--

T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
